send.description: The e-mail goes from your mailbox, linked to the deal, with the public link of the quote.

Here is our quote. You can see the details, accept or reject it through the link below:

{{link}}

Best regards.
send.linkHint: The text {{placeholder}} becomes the quote link; without it, the link goes at the end.

signature.title: Send for signature
signature.description: Generates the quote PDF with the Proposals module and sends it for electronic signature.
